questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a component of the business environment?
questions.explanation: Personal factors are not considered a component of the business environment. The main components include political, legal, economic, socio-cultural, and technological factors.

distractorRationale.a: Political factors are crucial as they affect regulations and government policies.
distractorRationale.b: Legal factors are essential for compliance and business operations.
distractorRationale.d: Economic factors directly influence market conditions and consumer behavior.

questions.stem: How can government policy hinder commerce?

options.text: By imposing high tariffs on imports

questions.explanation: High tariffs on imports can increase the cost of goods for consumers and limit competition, which can hinder commerce.

distractorRationale.a: Tax incentives generally encourage business growth and investment.
distractorRationale.c: Supporting local businesses typically helps commerce thrive.
distractorRationale.d: Promoting free trade agreements can enhance market access and competition.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a socio-cultural factor affecting business?
questions.explanation: Consumer preferences for local products reflect socio-cultural factors, as they are influenced by cultural values and trends.

distractorRationale.a: Changes in tax laws are a legal factor.
distractorRationale.c: Advancements in technology are classified under technological factors.
distractorRationale.d: Inflation rates are economic factors that affect pricing and purchasing power.
